list.name: teacher
list.label: Utilizzatore
list.query: SELECT first_name || ' ' || last_name AS __text, id AS __value FROM studio_metrics.teachers ORDER BY first_name, last_name, id
list.definition: SELECT first_name || ' ' || last_name AS __text, id AS __value FROM studio_metrics.teachers ORDER BY first_name, last_name, id

panels.title: Messaggi per utilizzatore e giorno

targets.rawSql:
SELECT date_trunc('day', received_at, 'Europe/Rome') AS time, coalesce(teacher_first_name || ' ' || teacher_last_name, 'Non censito') AS metric, count(*) AS value
FROM studio_metrics.usage_events
WHERE $__timeFilter(received_at) AND (-1 IN ($teacher) OR teacher_id IN ($teacher))
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1, 2

panels.description: Messaggi autenticati gestiti, per giorno (Europe/Rome) e utilizzatore.

panels.title: Messaggi per utilizzatore e tipo di turno

targets.rawSql:
SELECT coalesce(teacher_first_name || ' ' || teacher_last_name, 'Non censito') AS "Utilizzatore", count(*) AS "Messaggi",
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE turn_kind = 'agent') AS "Risposte dell'agente",
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE turn_kind = 'management') AS "Percorso gestionale",
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE turn_kind = 'fixed') AS "Risposte fisse",
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE turn_kind = 'rejected_command') AS "Comandi rifiutati"
FROM studio_metrics.usage_events
WHERE $__timeFilter(received_at) AND (-1 IN ($teacher) OR teacher_id IN ($teacher))
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 2 DESC, 1

panels.title: Tempi di risposta per giorno

targets.rawSql:
SELECT date_trunc('day', received_at, 'Europe/Rome') AS time,
  percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY total_ms) AS "Complessivo, mediana",
  percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY total_ms) AS "Complessivo, 95° percentile",
  percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY model_ms) AS "Modello, mediana",
  percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY model_ms) AS "Modello, 95° percentile"
FROM studio_metrics.usage_events
WHERE $__timeFilter(received_at) AND (-1 IN ($teacher) OR teacher_id IN ($teacher))
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

panels.description: Tempo complessivo dalla ricezione all'ultimo invio a Meta e tempo speso nel modello (solo risposte dell'agente).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY total_ms) AS "Complessivo, mediana",
  percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY total_ms) AS "Complessivo, 95° percentile",
  percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY model_ms) AS "Modello, mediana",
  percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY model_ms) AS "Modello, 95° percentile"
FROM studio_metrics.usage_events
WHERE $__timeFilter(received_at) AND (-1 IN ($teacher) OR teacher_id IN ($teacher))

SELECT date_trunc('day', received_at, 'Europe/Rome') AS time, sum(input_tokens) AS "Token in ingresso", sum(output_tokens) AS "Token in uscita"
FROM studio_metrics.usage_events
WHERE $__timeFilter(received_at) AND (-1 IN ($teacher) OR teacher_id IN ($teacher)) AND turn_kind = 'agent'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Contesto inviato e soglia di compattazione

targets.rawSql:
SELECT received_at AS time, context_percent AS "Contesto (% della finestra)",
  round(compaction_threshold_tokens * 100.0 / context_window, 2) AS "Soglia di compattazione (% della finestra)"
FROM studio_metrics.usage_events
WHERE $__timeFilter(received_at) AND (-1 IN ($teacher) OR teacher_id IN ($teacher)) AND turn_kind = 'agent' AND context_percent IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY 1

panels.description: Contesto dell'ultima richiesta principale di ogni risposta dell'agente, in percentuale della finestra del modello, e soglia di compattazione registrata con l'evento.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT date_trunc('day', received_at, 'Europe/Rome') AS time, coalesce(teacher_first_name || ' ' || teacher_last_name, 'Non censito') AS metric, sum(compactions) AS value
FROM studio_metrics.usage_events
WHERE $__timeFilter(received_at) AND (-1 IN ($teacher) OR teacher_id IN ($teacher)) AND turn_kind = 'agent'
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1, 2

panels.title: Costi per giorno

targets.rawSql:
SELECT date_trunc('day', received_at, 'Europe/Rome') AS time, sum(cost_usd) AS "Costo (USD)"
FROM studio_metrics.usage_events
WHERE $__timeFilter(received_at) AND (-1 IN ($teacher) OR teacher_id IN ($teacher)) AND turn_kind = 'agent'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

panels.description: Somma di usage.cost riportato da OpenRouter; le risposte senza costo riportato non sono stimate.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT coalesce(teacher_first_name || ' ' || teacher_last_name, 'Non censito') AS "Utilizzatore", sum(cost_usd) AS "Costo (USD)",
  count(*) AS "Risposte dell'agente", count(*) FILTER (WHERE cost_usd IS NULL) AS "Risposte senza costo"
FROM studio_metrics.usage_events
WHERE $__timeFilter(received_at) AND (-1 IN ($teacher) OR teacher_id IN ($teacher)) AND turn_kind = 'agent'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 2 DESC NULLS LAST, 1

SELECT coalesce(model, 'Non riportato') AS "Modello", sum(cost_usd) AS "Costo (USD)",
  count(*) AS "Risposte dell'agente", count(*) FILTER (WHERE cost_usd IS NULL) AS "Risposte senza costo"
FROM studio_metrics.usage_events
WHERE $__timeFilter(received_at) AND (-1 IN ($teacher) OR teacher_id IN ($teacher)) AND turn_kind = 'agent'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 2 DESC NULLS LAST, 1

panels.title: Invii rifiutati

targets.rawSql:
SELECT date_trunc('day', received_at, 'Europe/Rome') AS "Giorno", coalesce(teacher_first_name || ' ' || teacher_last_name, 'Non censito') AS "Utilizzatore", send_outcome AS "Esito",
  send_http_status AS "Stato HTTP", send_error_code AS "Codice Meta", count(*) AS "Messaggi"
FROM studio_metrics.usage_events
WHERE $__timeFilter(received_at) AND (-1 IN ($teacher) OR teacher_id IN ($teacher)) AND send_outcome IN ('refused', 'network')
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4, 5
ORDER BY 1 DESC, 2, 3, 4, 5

panels.description: Invii a Meta rifiutati (refused, con stato HTTP e codice d'errore) o senza risposta (network).
